# Repository Agent Skills

This repository contains selected skills from [Matt Pocock's skills repository](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), pinned at upstream commit b0618bc436ad893b3c5e84e55fba86586d34a404. The source is MIT-licensed; see MIT-LICENSE-Matt-Pocock. The upstream skill files and referenced support resources are included in each skill directory. codebase-design/SKILL.md has a short CivicMesh terminology note.

GitHub Copilot can load a relevant skill from this directory when its description matches the task. These files are guidance, not proof that a build, test, hardware assembly, field trial, or deployment happened.

## Installed skills

- **codebase-design** — see codebase-design/SKILL.md
- **diagnosing-bugs** — see diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md
- **domain-modeling** — see domain-modeling/SKILL.md
- **tdd** — see tdd/SKILL.md
- **pr** — see pr/SKILL.md

Use a skill only when its stated trigger fits the task. Repository documentation, existing interfaces, contributor guidance, security/privacy controls, and the user's explicit instructions take precedence where they conflict with generic skill guidance.
